Sales: Sales increased by 20% in May.
Customers: The number of customers grew from 800 to 1,200.
Prices: Our product prices increased slightly in 2025 due to higher ingredient costs.
Costs: Our company's costs fell to 40,000 baht.
Online: Our online followers saw a sharp rise this year.
Branches & staff: The number of branches and staff remained steady throughout the year.

Sales: Sales revenue increased by 20% in May, indicating a significant improvement in the hotel's financial performance.
Customers: The percentage of international guests at Doi Cloud Hotel increased steadily from 40% in January to 60% in June, representing an overall rise of 20 percentage points.
Prices: The hotel's room prices experienced a slight increase in 2025, reflecting changes in operating and ingredient costs.
Costs: The hotel's total operating costs decreased to 40,000 baht, demonstrating improved cost management and operational efficiency.
Online: The number of online followers increased sharply, indicating growing brand awareness and greater interest in Doi Cloud Hotel's services.
Branches & staff: The number of hotel staff at Doi Cloud Hotel rose from 25 employees in 2021 to 45 employees in 2025, marking an overall increase of 20 employees over the four-year period.

Sales: Our shop sells 120–280 drinks per month. Monthly sales increase over time, with the highest sales in June.
Customers: Our customers include new customers, regular customers, and online customers. Most customers enjoy our drinks and come back to buy again.
Prices: Our drinks cost 40 baht per cup. The ingredient cost is approximately 15 baht per cup.
Costs: Our main costs include shop rent, staff salaries, ingredients, electricity, and packaging materials.
Online: We promote our shop through Facebook, TikTok, and Instagram. We gain more followers, views, and online orders every month.
Branches & staff: Our business has one shop and three employees. Each employee helps with making drinks, serving customers, and managing the shop.

Branches & staff: The number of bakers increased from 5 in 2021 to 15 in 2025.

Customers: The number of regular and online customers grew steadily from 800 to 1,200 in 2025.

Sales: Sales increased by 50% from January to June, showing steady growth throughout the six months.
Customers: The number of customers increased by 31% from January to June, showing that more people visited the business.
Prices: The average selling price increased by 10% from January to June.
Costs: Business costs increased by 36% from January to June due to higher operating expenses.
